issue_description: Letter makes contradictory claim stating candidate graduated #1 class valedictorian in a non-graduating freshman semester.

entities.project: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Edge Devices

text:
DEPARTMENT OF INFORMATION SCIENCE
GLOBAL INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & ENGINEERING
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Aditya Verma, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2021-2023) at Global Institute of Science & Engineering.

During this tenure, Aditya Verma demonstrated exceptional mastery in Natural Language Processing, Transformers, FastAPI, PostgreSQL. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Edge Devices', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Remarkably, they graduated as the 4-year valedictorian after their 1st semester.

Beyond technical competence, Aditya Verma displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Aditya Verma among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Meenakshi Sundaram
Associate Professor
Information Science
Global Institute of Science & Engineering
Email: .meenakshi.sundaram@globalinst.edu
